items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So, Harold and you teamed up to become the new Chuck and Chuckles. [INTERVIEWEE] Right, yes, George.

ctx.x: It was Gloria Kroma's husband, Harold Kroma.

Yes, yes. He was known as the Monitor, you know, the Jazz Monitor, see, at that time. Sammy Davis, Jr., -- he was inspired by Harold Kroma, the Jazz Monitor. As you know, Sammy Davis, Jr., reached all heights, you know.
